content: विह्वल {%a.%} .²1 Agitated, disquieted, perturbed, confused; क्षणमात्रसखीं सुजातयोः स्तनयोस्तामवलोक्य विह्वला <ls>R. 8. 37</ls>. .²2 Overcome with fear, alarmed. .²3 Delirious, beside oneself. .²4 Afflicted, distressed; वित्तव्याधिविकारविह्वलगिरां नामापि न श्रूयते <ls>Bh. 3. 59</ls>; <ls>Ku. 4. 4</ls>. .²5 Desponding. .²6 Fused, liquid.
